          Product description

          These adidas sneakers bring a '70s vibe to your everyday look. The lightweight upper is lined for comfort while Cloudfoam cushioning keeps you powering through your routine. Go from your morning coffee run to an evening with friends in kicks that pair seamlessly with any outfit. A flexible rubber outsole lets you carry on with confidence, no matter where the day or night takes you.

          How customer reviews and ratings work

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

          To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

          Learn more how customers reviews work on Amazon

          Customers say

          Customers find these shoes to be nice trainers with a classic Adidas vibe and good value. The fit and sizing receive mixed feedback - while some find them a great fit, others say they're way too tight in the width and 1-2 sizes too small. The durability and build quality also get mixed reviews, with some saying they've held up great while others report build quality issues. Customers disagree on their suitability for all-day wear.

            I really liked the design of these and I really they've lasted pretty ok. They look good, fit to size and don't cost a lot however they do lose a star because as I've found with quite a few Adidas now they all seem to suffer the same problem inside at the heel; and that problem is wear. After a few wears the internal material started to bobble and after a couple of months the fabric was tearing making them ugly when not being worn and uncomfortable.

            They are a nice colour though and easy to clean by putting in the wash.

            My new favourite daily trainers

            Size: 8 UKColour: Core Black Cloud White Cloud White
            Verified Purchase
            Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
            Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

            The adidas Run 70s 2.0 have quickly become my new go-to trainers. They’ve got that classic adidas vibe — similar to the SL72 — but at a much friendlier price point. For what you pay, they feel really well made.

            Comfort-wise, they’re spot on. I’ve been wearing them as my daily pair and they’ve held up great. Good cushioning, lightweight, and easy to wear all day without any rubbing or sore spots.

            I’m a big adidas fan and used to live in the Bravada range, but since those were discontinued I’ve been looking for something to fill the gap. These do it perfectly.

            If you want that clean adidas style, solid comfort, and good value, these are a great shout.
